about.title: About — corrofea
about.heading: About
about.p1: This is corrofea's personal tech blog.
about.p2: Corrofea — corrode + feather = a feather eroded by time. Technology, like time, imperceptibly changes the texture of every feather. This blog records my thoughts, mistakes, and reflections in the world of programming.
about.p3: Main interests: frontend engineering, toolchains, server operations, and those moments of "I finally got it working after all the tinkering."
about.motto: Code becomes obsolete, feathers weather away, but the marks of erosion themselves carry meaning.
